title: The Only 25 Ways to Make Money in 2026
summary: Sorts ways to make money online into trash (NFTs, crypto, MLM, day trading, print-on-demand), easy AI services, medium agencies, and hard company-building plays.

assertions.quote: Those things don't work in 2026, especially not in the new era of AI.

verdicts.note: Both still produce income for some, but saturation and rising ad costs have cut newcomer odds; 'don't work' overstates it.

assertions.quote: most people lose money every freaking day

verdicts.note: Post-2022 NFT collections are mostly worthless and retail crypto trading studies show majority losses.

Simulation from app-download timing finds 75-81% of retail crypto users likely lost money (median -48% on $900 invested) with only a few making large gains; supports the crypto half of the claim, says nothing about NFT flipping.

assertions.quote: If the way you make money is getting paid to recruit people to join your thing

verdicts.note: Nationally representative probability sample of 601 current/former MLM participants: 47% reported losing money, 27% broke even and only 25% made any profit over their whole time in the MLM.

Across the 27 MLM disclosures giving the figure, the share of participants with no income exceeded 50% in 17, and staff's calculations show the vast majority received $1,000 or less per year (under $84/month) before expenses.
FTC summary of 70 income disclosures: most participants made $1,000 or less a year before expenses, and in at least 17 MLMs most participants made nothing at all.

Across 30 MLMs' own income disclosures, after subtracting required purchases and modest expenses, 99.12%-99.97% of participants (average 99.6%) lost money and about one in 238 profited; Nu Skin's own 2008 report shows 85.89% of active distributors earned no commission at all.

assertions.quote: AI tools have replaced this work completely

verdicts.note: Platform demand for transcription and basic data entry has collapsed; some human QA work remains.

assertions.quote: it's really crowded and everyone sells the same stuff

verdicts.note: Marketplace listing counts and seller reports show saturation in mainstream niches.

assertions.quote: it is way easier to lose money than to make any

verdicts.note: Retainers do stabilize income, but outcome pricing shifts risk to the seller and needs a track record.

assertions.quote: Most people fail not because they were in the wrong bucket, but because they switch buckets every few weeks.

verdicts.note: Persistence matters, but many ventures fail on unit economics regardless of focus.

assertions.quote: buying a boring business that somebody else is done with using AI is a great way to create real wealth

verdicts.note: Small-business acquisition can work, but it needs capital and operating skill; AI automation gains are anecdotal.
Small-business acquisition can pay off with capital and operating skill, but many acquisitions underperform and AI gains are anecdotal.
